Third-party components of the /d/untertitel demo
=================================================

This page is served together with the components below. They run in the visitor's browser.
The exact files and their SHA-256 digests are in PROVENANCE.json (same folder).

1. ffmpeg-core.js + ffmpeg-core.wasm  --  GPL-2.0-or-later
   Package: @ffmpeg/core 0.12.10 (npm), built by the ffmpeg.wasm project at tag v0.12.10.
   Contents: FFmpeg n5.1.4, configured with --enable-gpl and these libraries: x264, x265 3.4, libvpx 1.13.1,
   lame, libtheora 1.1.1, libvorbis 1.3.3, libopus 1.3.1, zlib 1.2.11, libwebp 1.3.2, freetype 2.10.4,
   fribidi 1.0.9, libass 0.15.0, zimg 3.0.5, plus HarfBuzz 5.2.0. Built with Emscripten 3.1.40.
   Because FFmpeg is built with --enable-gpl (x264, x265), the combined work is licensed under the
   GNU General Public License, version 2 or (at your option) any later version.
   Licence text: LICENSE.ffmpeg-gpl-2.0.txt
   Copyright: the FFmpeg developers; x264 project (2003-2022); MulticoreWare, Inc (x265, 2013-2020);
              the other libraries by their respective authors; ffmpeg.wasm glue code (c) 2019 Jerome Wu (MIT).
   Corresponding source code (this exact version):
     ffmpeg.wasm  https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/tree/v0.12.10  (commit c3a763857c5e)
     build recipe https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/blob/v0.12.10/Dockerfile  (lists every library and version)
     FFmpeg       https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/tree/n5.1.4  (commit 4729204c17f7)
     x264         https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/x264/tree/4-cores  (commit 33cac6b77d5b)
     x265         https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/x265/tree/3.4  (commit 2bb5520e9596)
     libvpx       https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/libvpx/tree/v1.13.1  (commit 10b9492dcf05)
     lame         https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/lame/tree/master  (commit 2badea1974ae)
     libass       https://github.com/libass/libass/tree/0.15.0  (commit d149636f502f)
   The commits are the ones the named tags and branches pointed to on 2026-10-31. The remaining libraries
   are named with their versions in the Dockerfile linked above.
   The file is unchanged from the npm package: its SHA-256 equals the one of @ffmpeg/core@0.12.10.

2. ffmpeg/*.js  --  MIT
   Package: @ffmpeg/ffmpeg 0.12.15. Copyright (c) 2019 Jerome Wu. Licence text: LICENSE.ffmpeg-wasm-mit.txt

3. shout.wasm.js  --  MIT
   Package: @transcribe/shout 1.0.7, Copyright (c) 2024 thurti. Licence text: LICENSE.shout.txt
   Contains whisper.cpp v1.8.2 (commit 4979e04f5dcaccb36057e059bbaed8a2f5288315), MIT,
   Copyright (c) 2023-2026 The ggml authors. Licence text: LICENSE.whisper-cpp-mit.txt
   Source: https://github.com/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/tree/v1.8.2

4. ggml-tiny-q5_1.bin, ggml-base-q5_1.bin  --  MIT
   OpenAI Whisper model weights, converted and quantised by whisper.cpp.
   Copyright (c) 2022 OpenAI. Licence text: LICENSE.openai-whisper-mit.txt
   Source: https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/tree/5359861c739e955e79d9a303bcbc70fb988958b1

5. Poppins-ExtraBold.ttf  --  SIL Open Font License 1.1
   Package: @expo-google-fonts/poppins 0.4.1. Licence text: LICENSE.poppins-ofl.txt
